div.head: VI Atr 28.2
div.ab: ⁊ swicollice dæda ⁊ laðlice unlaga ascunige man swyðe, þæt is false gewihta ⁊ woge gemeta ⁊ lease gewitnessa ⁊ fracodlice ficunga ⁊ fule forligra ⁊ egeslice mánswara
⁊ swicollice dæda ⁊ laðlice unlaga ascunige man swyðe, þæt is false gewihta ⁊ woge gemeta ⁊ lease gewitnessa ⁊ fracodlice ficunga ⁊ fule forligra ⁊ egeslice mánswara
And swicollice dæda and laðlice unlaga ascunige man swyðe: þæt is false gewihta and woge gemeta and lease gewitnessa and fracodlice ficunga and fule forligra and egeslice manswara;

Und betrügerische Handlungen und hässliche Rechtswidrigkeiten vermeide man sehr, nämlich falsche Gewichte und unrichtige Maasse und falsche Zeugnisse und schändliche Betrügereien und schmutzige Hurereien und furchtbare Meineide
And let deceitful deeds and hateful abuses be strictly shunned, namely false weights and wrong measures and lying witness and shameful frauds and foul fornications and terrible perjuries
And deceitful deeds and hateful injustices shall be strictly avoided, namely, untrue weights, and false measures, and lying testimonies,

And fraudulent deeds and hateful injustices are to be entirely rejected, that is: false weights and counterfeit measures and perjured testimony and shameful deceptions and foul adulteries and dreadful falsehoods;

note.seg: Cf. V, 24; 25; Wulfstan, pp. 129 f., 163 f.
